description: This PHP source file defines an authentication middleware for handling JWT-based authorization in an HTTP server, including token extraction, validation, and role assignment.

classes.name: AuthMiddleware
classes.description: A middleware class implementing authorization logic by validating JWT tokens, extracting user info, and assigning roles for incoming HTTP requests.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the middleware with dependencies: UserRepository, KeycloakService, Logger, and ApplicationConfig.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main method to process incoming requests, validate JWT, and set request attributes based on token claims.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Extracts the bearer token from query parameters or Authorization header; throws exception if missing or invalid.

methods.name: extractRoleFromToken
methods.description: Determines user role from the token's resource access claim.
